context_script-execution-method:
For YQL-scripts combining DDL and DML.

context_scan-execution-method:
Read-only queries, potentially reading a lot of data.

context_data-execution-method:
DML queries for changing and fetching data in serialization mode.

context_query-execution-method:
Any query. An experimental API call supposed to replace all existing methods.

context_serializable-transaction-mode: Provides the strictest isolation level for custom transactions
context_online-read-only-transaction-mod: Each read operation in the transaction is reading the data that is most recent at execution time
context_stale-read-only-transaction-mode: Read operations within a transaction may return results that are slightly out-of-date (lagging by fractions of a second)
context_snapshot-read-only-transaction-m: All the read operations within a transaction access the database snapshot. All the data reads are consistent
context_snapshot-read-write-transaction-: All the operations within a transaction access the database snapshot. All the data reads are consistent and writes are applied atomically
context_detailed-tracing-level: Highest detail applicable for diagnosing problems in production
context_top-level-tracing: Lowest detail, no more than two spans per request to the component
alert_explain-analyze-applies-changes: Any changes will be applied to the database. Query results are ignored.
alert_query-settings-modified: Query execution settings have been changed
alert_modified-query-settings: Query was executed with modified settings:
alert_query-stopped-outdated-data: Data is not up to date because the request was not completed.
